a.doc AS final_document, v.code AS disposition, pk.pack AS cr_pack FROM dk a JOIN vdisp v ON v.target = a.k JOIN dk b ON b.doc = a.doc JOIN memb mb ON mb.cr = b.k JOIN pkeys pk ON pk.k = mb.pack_id

WITH pk0(k) AS (SELECT id FROM cr_pack WHERE (pack_number = 'RP-192190' OR id = 'RP-192190') AND id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT pack_number FROM cr_pack WHERE (pack_number = 'RP-192190' OR id = 'RP-192190') AND pack_number IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT 'RP-192190'), mem(k) AS (SELECT cr FROM cr_in_pack WHERE pack_id IN (SELECT k FROM pk0) AND cr IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT cr FROM pack_member WHERE pack_id IN (SELECT k FROM pk0) AND cr IS NOT NULL), dk(doc, k) AS (SELECT COALESCE(d.number, d.id), d.id FROM document d WHERE (d.id IN (SELECT k FROM mem) OR d.number IN (SELECT k FROM mem)) AND d.id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT COALESCE(d.number, d.id), d.number FROM document d WHERE (d.id IN (SELECT k FROM mem) OR d.number IN (SELECT k FROM mem)) AND d.number IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT s.k, s.k FROM mem s WHERE s.k IS NOT NULL AND s.k NOT IN (SELECT id FROM document WHERE id IS NOT NULL) AND s.k NOT IN (SELECT number FROM document WHERE number IS NOT NULL)), vdisp(target, code, wg_meeting) AS (SELECT dp.target, dp.code, COALESCE(m.label, m.id) FROM disposition dp JOIN resolution r ON r.id = dp.resolution_id JOIN meeting m ON m.id = r.meeting_id WHERE dp.target IN (SELECT k FROM dk) AND LOWER(COALESCE(dp.evidence_status, '')) LIKE '%verified%' AND LOWER(COALESCE(dp.evidence_status, '')) NOT LIKE '%unverified%' AND LOWER(COALESCE(dp.evidence_status, '')) NOT LIKE '%not_verified%' AND LOWER(COALESCE(dp.evidence_status, '')) NOT LIKE '%notverified%' AND LOWER(COALESCE(dp.evidence_status, '')) NOT LIKE '%non_verified%' AND LOWER(COALESCE(dp.evidence_status, '')) NOT LIKE '%nonverified%' AND LOWER(COALESCE(dp.evidence_status, '')) NOT LIKE '%partial%' AND (LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(dp.scope, ''))) LIKE '%whole%' OR LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(dp.scope, ''))) LIKE '%entire%' OR LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(dp.scope, ''))) IN ('document', 'doc', 'tdoc', 'full', 'full_document', 'full document', 'full-document', 'all')) AND (m.wg IS NULL OR TRIM(m.wg) = '' OR m.wg LIKE '%2%' OR COALESCE(m.label, '') LIKE '%RAN2%' OR COALESCE(m.label, '') LIKE '%R2%' OR COALESCE(m.label, '') LIKE '%WG2%')) SELECT DISTINCT a.doc AS document, v.code AS disposition, v.wg_meeting AS wg_meeting FROM dk a JOIN vdisp v ON v.target = a.k

WITH dk(doc, k) AS (SELECT COALESCE(number, id), id FROM document WHERE (number = 'R2-2506547' OR id = 'R2-2506547') AND id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT COALESCE(number, id), number FROM document WHERE (number = 'R2-2506547' OR id = 'R2-2506547') AND number IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT 'R2-2506547', 'R2-2506547'), memb(cr, pack_id) AS (SELECT cr, pack_id FROM cr_in_pack WHERE cr IN (SELECT k FROM dk) UNION SELECT cr, pack_id FROM pack_member WHERE cr IN (SELECT k FROM dk)), pkeys(k, pack, tsg_meeting) AS (SELECT id, COALESCE(pack_number, id), tsg_meeting FROM cr_pack WHERE id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT pack_number, COALESCE(pack_number, id), tsg_meeting FROM cr_pack WHERE pack_number IS NOT NULL) SELECT DISTINCT pk.pack AS cr_pack, pk.tsg_meeting AS tsg_meeting FROM memb mb JOIN pkeys pk ON pk.k = mb.pack_id
